body.intent: The interim model is deleted: writes take their model and base versions from the projection under the strict rules, api/model.go's newModel, newModelSets and their apply rules, Ctx.readLog and every IndexPath branch go, and a worktree with no usable index cache reads through a throwaway index, so there is one read path and one set of model rules. Evidence: about a dozen ops branch on IndexPath (write.go:189, read.go:180/197/222, inbox.go:602, ship.go:359, run_model_cache.go:88, repair.go:161) and three clear it (daemon_projects.go:46, question.go:182, web_actions.go:108).
